metadata.description: Claude Code skills from @0x45.dev for making YouTube videos for $0: make-video, snipshorts (free OpusClip alternative) and cartoonsmith.

plugins.name: make-video
plugins.description: Idea → script → voice → captions → music → Remotion render → QA, for $0. Free, local, no API keys.

plugins.name: snipshorts
plugins.description: Free, open-source OpusClip alternative, no watermark: a podcast or interview link → vertical Shorts with the speaker tracked, captions, SFX and posting copy. Add-on to make-video.

plugins.name: cartoonsmith
plugins.description: Voiced cartoon episodes with recurring characters: talking rigs from your character sheets, lip sync, captions, music, render and QA. Free and local. Add-on to make-video.
